mapper.sql: left join basket_team t on t.id = c.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = c.submit_user_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_account acc on acc.id = c.submit_user_id and acc.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = c.submit_player_id and p.is_delete = 0
mapper.select:
select c.id, c.change_no as changeNo, c.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, c.submit_user_id as submitUserId, mp.nickname as submitUserName, acc.email as submitUserEmail, c.audit_status as auditStatus, c.create_time as submitTime, c.audit_time as auditTime, c.old_team_name as oldTeamName, c.new_team_name as newTeamName, c.old_team_short_name as oldTeamShortName, c.new_team_short_name as newTeamShortName, c.old_logo_file_id as oldLogoFileId, c.new_logo_file_id as newLogoFileId, c.old_description as oldDescription, c.new_description as newDescription from basket_team_profile_change c
where c.is_delete = 0 and c.change_no like concat('%', #{changeNo}, '%') and t.team_name like concat('%', #{teamName}, '%')
and (mp.nickname like concat('%', #{submitUser}, '%') or acc.email like concat('%', #{submitUser}, '%'))
and c.audit_status in (1, 2) and c.audit_status = 3 and c.audit_status = 4 and c.audit_status = 5
and c.audit_status = #{auditStatus} and c.create_time >= #{beginTime} and c.create_time <= #{endTime} order by c.create_time desc, c.id desc

select c.id, c.change_no as changeNo, c.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, c.old_team_name as oldTeamName, c.new_team_name as newTeamName, c.old_team_short_name as oldTeamShortName, c.new_team_short_name as newTeamShortName, c.old_logo_url as oldLogoUrl, c.new_logo_url as newLogoUrl, c.old_description as oldDescription, c.new_description as newDescription, c.old_public_status as oldPublicStatus, c.new_public_status as newPublicStatus, c.change_reason as changeReason, c.audit_status as auditStatus, c.submit_user_id as submitUserId, mp.nickname as submitUserName, acc.email as submitUserEmail, p.player_no as submitPlayerNo, c.create_time as submitTime, c.audit_time as auditTime, c.audit_user_id as auditUserId, c.audit_remark as auditRemark from basket_team_profile_change c
where c.id = #{id} and c.is_delete = 0
select * from basket_team_profile_change where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
mapper.update: update basket_team_profile_change set audit_status = #{toStatus}, audit_user_id = #{auditUserId}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, active_flag = #{activeFlag}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and audit_status in #{s}
